videos.title: How To Build A Jet Engine From Scratch
videos.description:
On November 21, 2026, Boom Supersonic (YC W16) fired its prototype engine core for the first time. In this episode of Hard Tech, YC’s Jared Friedman goes inside Boom’s Colorado Superpower Superfactory with founder and CEO Blake Scholl to see how they are building a jet engine from scratch.

The company is developing a shared core for two products: Superpower, a natural-gas turbine for AI data centers, and Symphony, the engine intended for the Overture supersonic airliner. Blake explains why Boom decided to build its own engine and its plan to use turbine revenue and operating data to help develop Overture.

On the factory floor, we explore in-house manufacturing, the challenge of making turbine blades survive extreme heat, and the custom software Boom uses to design and iterate on engine parts.

https://boomsupersonic.com
